mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_item WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{itemId})
mapper.sql: i.owner_id,i.id,i.revision,i.correction_id,c.excerpt_id AS root_excerpt_id, c.created_at AS correction_created_at,i.source_domain,i.material_source_excerpt_id, i.knowledge_source_item_id,i.knowledge_source_version_id,source.version_number AS source_version_number, source.title AS source_title,i.task_id,t.purpose AS task_purpose,t.status AS task_status, i.target_item_id,target.title AS target_title,i.target_version_id, target.version_number AS target_version_number,i.depth,i.parent_impact_id,i.created_at, i.choice,i.reason,i.resolution_target_version_id,i.resolution_target_revision,i.decided_at, d.status AS adoption_status,material.task_id AS material_binding_task_id,knowledge.task_id AS knowledge_binding_task_id

FROM material_knowledge_impact i LEFT JOIN material_excerpt_correction c ON c.owner_id=i.owner_id AND c.id=i.correction_id LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=i.owner_id AND t.id=i.task_id LEFT JOIN ai_candidate_decision d ON d.owner_id=i.owner_id AND d.task_id=i.task_id AND d.target_item_id=i.target_item_id AND d.target_version_id=i.target_version_id LEFT JOIN ai_material_draft_source material ON material.owner_id=i.owner_id AND material.task_id=i.task_id AND material.excerpt_id=i.material_source_excerpt_id LEFT JOIN ai_knowledge_source knowledge ON knowledge.owner_id=i.owner_id AND knowledge.task_id=i.task_id AND knowledge.source_item_id=i.knowledge_source_item_id AND knowledge.source_version_id=i.knowledge_source_version_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version source ON source.owner_id=i.owner_id AND source.item_id=i.knowledge_source_item_id AND source.id=i.knowledge_source_version_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version target ON target.owner_id=i.owner_id AND target.item_id=i.target_item_id AND target.id=i.target_version_id
mapper.select: SELECT i.id,i.status,i.metadata_revision AS revision,i.current_version_id,v.version_number AS current_version_number, v.title AS published_title,v.body AS published_body,d.title AS draft_title,d.body AS draft_body, adopted.version_number AS adopted_version_number,adopted.body AS adopted_body FROM knowledge_item i LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=i.current_version_id AND v.version_number=i.version_number LEFT JOIN knowledge_draft d ON d.item_id=i.id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version adopted ON adopted.owner_id=i.owner_id AND adopted.item_id=i.id AND adopted.id=#{adoptedVersionId} WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{itemId}
mapper.update: UPDATE material_knowledge_impact i SET i.revision=1,i.choice=#{choice},i.reason=#{reason},i.resolution_target_version_id=#{targetVersionId}, i.resolution_target_revision=#{targetRevision},i.decided_at=#{now} WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.target_item_id=#{itemId} AND i.id=#{impactId} AND i.revision=#{expected} AND i.revision=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_item k WHERE k.owner_id=i.owner_id AND k.id=i.target_item_id AND k.metadata_revision=#{targetRevision} AND k.current_version_id=#{targetVersionId})
